sloka: गृहाण पाणिम् माण्डव्याः पाणिना रघुनंदन ।शत्रुघ्नम् च अपि धर्माअत्मा अब्रवीत् मिथिलेश्वरः ॥१-७३-३२॥
transliteration: gṛhāṇa pāṇim māṇḍavyāḥ pāṇinā raghunaṁdana ।śatrughnam ca api dharmāatmā abravīt mithileśvaraḥ ॥1-73-32॥

translations.english: Janaka, having spoken thus to Lakshmana addressed Bharata: "O Descendant of the Raghus hold Mandavi's hand in your own".
